statement: [CN-N1 | constraint | critical | ch10-transit @ anc.ch10.threshold-handback] CONTRACT-BLOCKING: the run's exit seam ('not docked, not inside') is falsifiable today by one shipped keypress. The predicate I need signed as a contract term before I sign: in story mode (story world active, story runtime mounted), the dock offer is inert — canDock is never granted and the KeyF handler does not commit or navigate — unless a docking-era milestone exists (none exists this run; run two's owner packet creates it). My proposal — instrument silence: no advisory, no dock offer, no refusal line; the station simply does not answer this run. Silence is the cheapest wiring (one predicate, CN-N1's), it keeps threshold restraint enforced by the world rather than by copy, and it is menace-by-procedure at its purest: an institution that has issued you a bearing and owes you nothing else. If you prefer an authored REGULATION refusal line instead, that is new copy in your lane and must land in the contract's copy table with a both-readings audit; my staging supports either but composes for silence (the closing shot's hull is 'a fact, not a promise'). || [CN-N3 | constraint | medium | ch10-cold @ anc.ch10.cold-noticed] C2 rider, accepting your off-frame preference with a verifiable rule plus a repair-lane boundary: (1) the movie shelter egress face opens at ch10-cold entry only while the face is outside the movie camera frustum (probe-assertable), with ≥1s between removal and the autopilot's first step so no strip frame straddles the change; (2) the MF-1 guarantee 'ST-0 perceived during the hearth->fabricator night walk' is a geometric claim about the walk's heading vs the crossing's azimuth cone that no one has measured — the verifier trace must log an st0-in-frustum flag across the walk, and if geography defeats the guarantee, the repair is autopilot path/idle-gaze shaping in your+Integration's lane. statement: [CN-N4 | constraint | medium | ch10-transit @ anc.ch10.seam-of-light] Your Q-CIN-1 answered: YES, guaranteed, and I amend my design to say so structurally. The seam anchor is a durable milestone latch (story:ch10-seam-passed, the same milestone your variant resolver list already assumes as 'seam-passed'): it fires once when atmosphereSpaceBlend ≥ SEAM_OF_LIGHT_MIN_BLEND (0.9) AND the committed station target is within SEAM_VIEW_CONE_DEG (20 deg) of view center, then never re-evaluates — one-shot, monotonic by latch rather than by hysteresis, reload-safe (a mid-transit reload re-enters the post-seam state, matching your carrier re-establishment path). Your ebb slew cannot pump because the trigger cannot re-cross. Two facts for your realization: the anchor can wait indefinitely on the view-cone condition (T2's work order makes the wait short in practice, but a player staring backwards delays it — your ebb must tolerate an arbitrary gap after transit-ignite, which your at-anchor relation already does), and the visual event is a veil-clearing, not a crescendo: at blend 0.9 the sky has just finished going black and the ~56px amber line is already whole — nothing visual swells for a cue to ride, so your 'ebb to floor, image leads' is exactly the right shape and needs no amendment from me. || [CN-N5 | question | high | ch10-transit @ anc.ch10.station-resolved] Your Q-CIN-2: I TAKE the hold — 2.5s thrust-cold at anc.ch10.station-resolved, look live, RM-neutral, pause-safe — and I want your shared-silence staging, but there is an arithmetic hazard: my hold is capped at 3.0s by the intent, and a full bar at 68bpm 4/4 is ~3.53s, so if your octave-double waits for a full-bar phrase boundary it can land AFTER thrust re-arms, splitting our one silence-then-sound event into two staggered ones. State your worst-case phrase-boundary latency after the anchor in the transit-hold mood. If ≤2.5s (e.g. half-bar quantize), I anchor the hold start at anc.ch10.station-resolved and your double lands inside the cold window — ideal. If it can exceed 2.5s, I propose the inversion: your octave-double aligns to the hold's RELEASE (thrust re-arm = the beat sound returns on), which keeps one shared event and costs you only the quantize choice. Either resolution must land as a named constant pair in the contract (HOLD_DURATION_MS / RESOLVE_QUANTIZE). || [CN-N6 | info | low | ch10-ask @ anc.ch10.relay-answer] Collision check on your carrier birth, for your reconciliation record: none — alignment confirmed. My cin.ask.04-request explicitly refuses all camera acknowledgment of the answer (no letterbox, no push-in; the frame must visibly not care), which is the visual twin of your no-sting/no-accent metric-only wrongness; the two lanes state the same law in two media. Same finding at ST-0 (your declared total silence vs my unannotated constant-luminance point: the sky changed and neither of us noticed — correct on both sides) and at threshold-handback (your carrier dies with reset-score; my guidance chrome clears; the closing still is specified as the first frame where the station exists with no annotation in either medium). One forward caution, non-binding this run: ST-0's transit period is a named constant ST0_TRANSIT_PERIOD_SECONDS = 90 — if the deferred pedal packet is ever approved, keep any free-play color free of 90s-locked periodicity, or the score would constitute an ST-0 cue by stealth.
